main.description: Refused when the organization did not invite the caller, the caller keeps no acceptance record naming it, or the invitation lapsed.

visibility.description: Which of the caller's acceptance records counts, should they keep one in public and one in the organization's space, as they do moving it: a hidden one, if asked for; else a public one first.

org.description: The organization's handle, or its DID when none resolves back to it.

visibility.description: Who sees the membership: anyone, or the organization's members.

description: Takes the caller into an organization that invited them, once they keep a dev.knotless.orgAcceptance record naming it, through the gateway the organization delegated writes to: names them in its public record when their acceptance record is public, and only in its space when it is in their repo there; lets them read its space and its private repositories. Called again after moving the record, it changes how the membership shows. Refused when the invitation lapsed. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the gateway's DID, for this method.
